# DraCuLa StreamNZB Template 6.3.0 — release notes draft

<!-- Auto-generated draft, seeded verbatim from the CHANGELOG section below. Condense for public release-note tone before merging the release-preparation PR -- this is a review starting point, not final prose. -->

## Changes

### Added

- **scoring:** reserve a bounded Best-N slot for Library releases (audited 2026-09-16 as classification A — an intentional retention-policy expansion, not a bug fix alone). Previously a Library-attached result could be silently evicted from the ordinary `Best 3 per R/Q` ceiling whenever three or more higher-scoring, non-Library alternatives shared the same `resolution + quality` bucket, even though nothing in DraCuLa's scoring policy wants a user's own already-verified Library copy hidden (native Library already carries StreamNZB's own `+500`). `Best 3 per R/Q`'s existing `when` now additionally excludes Library candidates (`not library`, rule name unchanged — no downstream linked-profile rename), and a new Core `limit` rule `Best 1 Library per R/Q` (count 1, the same `resolution + quality` `group_by`, matching Library candidates only, excluding Series/Anime season packs exactly as the ordinary rule does) reserves exactly one additional slot. A bucket's maximum retained size is therefore ordinarily still 3, and up to 4 when a qualifying Library candidate is present — a deliberate, bounded ceiling expansion. Multiple Library candidates in one bucket remain capped at the single highest-ranked one; a Library candidate cannot consume both an ordinary and the Library slot (real-engine-proven: excluding Library from the ordinary rule is what makes the reservation effective — a sibling cap added without that exclusion is a no-op, the Library candidate is still evicted by the ordinary cap first). Existing `Best 1 Season Pack per R/Q` and both SeaDex `limit` rules (`At most 1 SeaDex Best`/`At most 1 SeaDex Alternative`) are untouched and unaffected; Library Series/Anime season packs receive **no** dedicated reservation and continue through the existing, unmodified season-pack cap on their own merit (a known, documented scope boundary — trusted-tier reservation is explicitly out of scope too and remains separately deferred). Native Library scoring, adaptive filtering (Library was already `not library`-exempt from every reject/prune rule that references it), release-group tier authority, and `matched()`/aggregate/score-breakdown semantics are all unaffected — `limit` actions carry no score expression and cannot touch any of them. Samsung `profile.txt` 151→**152** rules, hardware-neutral `profile-neutral.txt` 150→**151** rules, Core ownership 129→**130** (presentation 21 and Samsung device 1 unchanged); Define Library unchanged at 62.
- **testing:** add `tests/streamnzb_compat/best_n_library_test.go`, 8 permanent real-engine regressions against the exact published rules (decoded from `profile.txt` by name, mirroring `season_pack_limits_test.go`'s production-regression pattern): the canonical eviction case is fixed and the true bucket maximum is 4; ordinary behavior is unchanged with no Library candidate present; multiple Library candidates remain bounded to the highest-ranked one; a Library candidate far below the ordinary candidates on real production scoring still survives; Library season packs get no dedicated protection and the existing season-pack cap stays authoritative; the existing global SeaDex-Best cap is unaffected by a Library+SeaDex-Best candidate; a Library candidate carrying a real Vidhin-backed LQ classification remains exempt from Adaptive Low-Score Filtering exactly as before; and a structural + behavioral double-match control proves a Library candidate cannot consume both ordinary and Library capacity. `tests/test_profile_defines.py`'s `validate_season_pack_limits()` extended to cover the three-rule partition (general/Library/season-pack) instead of the prior two-rule check. Every hardcoded rule/owner-count literal bumped to the new 152/151/130 figures (`build_profiles.py`, `profiles/variants.json`, `tests/test_profile_variants.py`, `tests/test_profile_defines.py`, `tests/test_check_release.py`'s live-baseline assertion, `TestNeutralProfileSchemaCompatibility`).
- **docs:** document the Best-N/Library reservation policy in `docs/SCORING.md` ("Availability and Library scoring"); mention it concisely in the README feature summary.
